However, the flamingos show structural artifacts: legs appear stick-like with poor joint definition where they meet water, some fusion/melting at waterline, and the pose auditor flagged HIGH artifact risk with 41% low-confidence keypoints concentrated in face and hind limb regions. The extra flamingo (6-7 instead of 5) also indicates generation inconsistency. Overall authenticity is moderate due to these anatomical imperfections in the birds despite the flawless croissant.
